description: This PHP source file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class `UserDao` for managing user-related database operations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and searching user data, as well as utility functions for handling user roles and validation.
external_methods: Expr methods such as isNotNull(), isNull(), in(), eq()

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: A DAO class providing methods to access and manipulate user data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes CRUD and search functionalities, user role handling, and validation methods.

methods.name: saveSystemUser
methods.description: Persists a User entity (system user) to the database.

methods.name: isExistingSystemUser
methods.description: Checks if a user with given credentials exists and is active.

methods.name: getSystemUser
methods.description: Retrieves a User entity by user ID if not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getExistingSystemUserIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing users from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getSystemUserIdList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all active (not deleted) user IDs.

methods.name: deleteSystemUsers
methods.description: Soft deletes users by setting their 'deleted' flag to true.

methods.name: getAssignableUserRoles
methods.description: Retrieves roles that are assignable to users.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Fetches a UserRole entity based on role name.

methods.name: getSearchSystemUsersCount
methods.description: Returns the count of users matching search filters.

methods.name: searchSystemUsers
methods.description: Returns a list of users matching the search filters.

methods.name: getSearchUserPaginator
methods.description: Creates a paginator object for paginated user search results based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeesByUserRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees with a specific user role, with options to include inactive or terminated employees.

methods.name: isUserNameExistByUserName
methods.description: Checks if a username already exists, optionally excluding a specific user ID.

methods.name: getUserByUserName
methods.description: Retrieves a user entity based on username.

methods.name: getDefaultAdminUser
methods.description: Fetches the default admin user (created by null, has password).
